name: query_logs
description:
Returns logs for a branch. Pass `limit` to cap how many. There is no `cursor` argument. Filters combine with AND. Pass `logql` instead of structured filters, not with them. Give the window as `since` or `start_time`, not both; default is the previous hour, max seven days; `end_time` is exclusive. Private beta; a branch without logs access returns HTTP 404 with reason "telemetry_not_enabled".

branch_id is a branch id (br-...), not a branch name. Call list_branches to resolve a name.

project_id.description: Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
